name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. Non-resident bonus treatment (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: A separately taxed annual bonus is a resident election (MOF/STA 2023 No.30); the non-resident bonus rule (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) is not transcribed.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). authority: Shanghai housing fund 2,740–37,731, equal 5–7% each side, supplementary 1–5% each side if elected; 沪公积金管委会〔2026〕3号 of 18 August 2026, from 1 July 2026 (issuer host www.shzfgjj.cn does not resolve, 29 Sep 2026; the 5–7% rates are confirmed only by centre-attributed republications, register CN-SH40). name: IIT on an early-retirement lump sum (提前退休一次性补贴收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2) (from 1 Jan 2019; STA copy https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202364/content.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 应纳税额={〔（一次性补贴收入÷办理提前退休手续至法定退休年龄的实际年度数）－费用扣除标准〕×适用税率－速算扣除数}×实际年度数, alone on the annual comprehensive table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The 费用扣除标准 is the annual 60,000 of IIT Law art.6(1) (综合所得…减除费用六万元). Y is the exit fact iit164_early_retirement_years. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on a part year; default the actual years as recorded (a fraction allowed), because 实际年度数 names the real span. Tax to the fen. Item 5(3) internal retirement (国税发〔1999〕58号: the lump sum ÷ months to statutory age, merged with that month’s wage on the monthly rate) is transcribed separately as IIT_INTERNAL_RETIREMENT (register CN-N39). A non-resident refuses.

name: IIT on an internal-retirement lump sum (内部退养一次性收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(3) and 国税发〔1999〕58号 item 1 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5193283/content.html): spread the one-off income across the months remaining to statutory retirement age, merge one share with this month’s wages less the RMB5,000 monthly deduction to choose the monthly rate, then charge that rate on this month’s wage plus the whole one-off less RMB5,000, with the quick deduction once. The wage remains in ordinary cumulative IIT. Item 1 is silent on how its combined charge meets the wage’s own cumulative withholding under STA 2018 No.61; owner rule 2026-09-28 default (register CN-N39): the simulated wage-only monthly tax is deducted from the combined tax, so only the one-off subsidy is assessed here — the reading the non-binding STA Shanxi 2021 annual-settlement FAQ, question 20, also takes (https://shanxi.chinatax.gov.cn/web/detail/sx-11400-548-1752086). A non-resident or a missing remaining-month declaration refuses.
